title: Seasonal Trading in Commodity Futures: Evidence from Regression and Singular Spectrum Signals
abstract: arXiv:2609.12227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Commodity futures are shaped by harvest cycles, weather shocks, storage conditions, and seasonal demand, but it remains unclear whether recurring patterns yield robust out-of-sample trading profits. Existing research documents return seasonality in commodity futures as well as more complex seasonal structure, while leaving less evidence on how alternative seasonal models compare under common implementation constraints. This article compares dummy-variable regression (DVR), Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA), and robust low-rank SSA (RLSSA) within a unified trading framework, including a volatility-normalised specification. Using monthly delivery-avoidance returns for 15 liquid commodity futures, the models are estimated on rolling ten-year windows and evaluated from 2016 to 2024 with transaction costs, an equal-weight long benchmark, and Maximum Entropy Bootstrap (MEB) assessment. translated_title: 商品期货的季节性交易：来自回归与奇异谱信号的证据
translated_abstract: 商品期货受收获周期、天气冲击、储存条件和季节性需求的影响，但这些反复出现的规律是否能带来稳健的样本外交易利润仍不明确。现有研究记录了商品期货收益的季节性以及更复杂的季节性结构，但在共同实施约束下对不同季节性模型进行比较的证据较少。本文在统一的交易框架内比较了虚拟变量回归、奇异谱分析以及稳健低秩奇异谱分析（RLSSA），其中包括波动率标准化设定。基于15种高流动性商品期货的月度交割规避收益，模型在滚动十年窗口上进行估计，并结合交易成本、等权重多头基准以及最大熵自举（MEB）评估，对2016年至2024年期间的表现进行评价。在500条MEB路径中，基准策略具有最强的平均……
tldr: 本文在统一的交易框架下系统比较了虚拟变量回归、奇异谱分析与稳健低秩奇异谱分析三种季节性信号模型在15种商品期货上的样本外交易表现，并结合交易成本、等权重基准与最大熵自举评估其稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper compares dummy-variable regression, Singular Spectrum Analysis, and robust low-rank SSA as seasonal trading signals in a unified framework across 15 commodity futures, evaluated out-of-sample (2016–2024) with transaction costs, an equal-weight long benchmark, and Maximum Entropy Bootstrap robustness testing.
